lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cs2Ag2As2F12 (reduced formula CsAgAsF6) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination for Ag and As, each with six F neighbors, while Cs shows a close-packed-like local arrangement of twelve F neighbors. Corner-sharing is observed between Ag- and As-centered octahedra, and face-sharing occurs between Ag octahedra and Cs 12-vertex polyhedra, with the geometric neighbor graph forming a single three-dimensional component.
